description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for a new paid subscription, or a Stripe Billing Portal link for an existing Stripe subscription. Use only after the user explicitly asks to upgrade or fix billing.

confirm.description: Required true to create a Stripe-hosted payment or billing link.

planCode.description: Target plan code, e.g. favcrm-lite. Either planId or planCode is required.

planId.description: Target plan ID. Use list_plan_options first if unknown.

returnUrl.description: Where Stripe should return after checkout/portal. Defaults to merchant billing settings.

name: create_plan_upgrade_link

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
